title: A typed undo stack
hints: Store the elements in an array field that only the class can see: `#items: T[] = [];` (or `private items: T[] = [];`).
`push` and `pop` map directly onto the array's own methods. `peek` is the last element: `this.#items[this.#items.length - 1]`. `size` is a getter: `get size(): number { ... }`.

In `pop`, check first: `if (this.#items.length === 0) throw new Error("Stack is empty");` — after that check the array can't be empty, so `return this.#items.pop()!;` is safe (`!` tells TypeScript it isn't `undefined`).
